{{Quote|If the Empire conquers the galaxy, freedom will be the first casualty.''"<br />"''Along with phaseball, mom and sweet flatcakes. I get it.|The Hero of Tython and Kira Carsen|<ref name="Escaping Korriban" />}}
'''Phaseball''' was a ball sport that was played during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. While speaking with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]] sarcastically declared that phaseball would be among the first casualties if the Empire was victorious over the Republic.<ref name="Escaping Korriban" />

==Behind the scenes==
Phaseball was mentioned the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Escaping Korriban" />
